Captures the architecture, environments, and resource topology of a Bedrock AgentCore development account (111122223333) spanning us-west-2 (dev-pdx) and us-east-1 (dev-iad). Use during incident investigation to identify affected components, find relevant logs, and understand resource relationships.

## Environments

- **dev-pdx**: AWS(111122223333, us-west-2) — Primary development environment. Hosts the Bedrock AgentCore runtime logging and CDK bootstrap tooling.
- **dev-iad**: AWS(111122223333, us-east-1) — Secondary development/test environment. Hosts the EMR Test Cluster and the N. **EMR Test Cluster** — The EMR Test Cluster container is a single EC2 instance in us-east-1 (dev-iad) used for data-processing test and experimentation workloads. It is named "emr-test-cluster" via its SSH key pair, suggesting it was provisioned for EMR or similar data-processing testing. The instance runs in a dedicated VPC and subnet with an attached EBS volume, ENI, and security group.

## Notes

- Two additional security groups exist in us-east-1 (sg-04f42ff8fc1e0a1cd, sg-0c91abd6e0217049e) with no discovered edge to the instance; they are likely unused and are not confirmed as workload-attached.


**Bedrock AgentCore** — The Bedrock AgentCore container represents the AI agent runtime workload in this account. Its primary deployment is in us-west-2 (dev-pdx), where a CloudWatch log group captures runtime execution; a second cell in us-east-1 (dev-iad) captures Bedrock model-invocation logs. The workload is supported by CDK bootstrap tooling (CDKToolkit stack, ECR asset repo, S3 asset bucket, and IAM roles) provisioned for us-west-2 deployments.

Note: the AgentCore runtime resource (`harness_harness_atvai-W4gOUEEv2z-DEFAULT`) is not currently present as a discrete resource in the topology graph — it was probed as both `AWS::Bedrock::AgentCore` and `AWS::BedrockAgentCore::Runtime` in us-west-2 with no results. Its runtime CloudWatch log group persists and encodes the runtime name, so the runtime identity is inferred from log-group evidence."}]}
